cards.title: Unbiased Sparse NCA Estimation Conditions
cards.claim: For batch designs with multiple time points per subject, the documented Phoenix sparse sampling methodology requires equal sample sizes per time point for its unbiased-estimate claim. The documentation also requires no missing data for the sparse routines. These implementation-specific conditions do not establish that all unequal-n destructive-sampling AUC estimators are biased.
conditions: Batch designs with multiple time points per subject
required_inputs: Complete dataset with no missing observations
Balanced sample sizes across time points
limitations: In the documented Phoenix batch implementation, unequal sample sizes per time point introduce bias in parameter estimates.
Missing data violates the unbiasedness condition for these specific sparse routines.
cards.downstream_use: Quality control of sparse datasets before analysis; identifying bias risks in unbalanced designs.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
